explication: Caddy is an extensible HTTPS server platform. The principal workflow is: an operator or API client supplies Caddyfile/JSON configuration; configuration is adapted and loaded into Caddy apps; listeners accept HTTP traffic; TLS is negotiated and routes dispatch requests to handlers such as reverse proxy or file server; responses return to clients. Automatic certificate management, persistent certificate storage, local PKI, dynamic administration, logging, and metrics are additional product capabilities. Some subsystem links reflect documented behavior because only selected source excerpts were sampled.
